description: Pause or resume ONE campaign cadence, or archive it. Pausing prevents new sends and freezes the schedule. Resuming may send the next due step immediately when inside the business window. "archived" keeps the people, the sends, the replies and the reports, stops everything and takes it out of the campaign list; "paused" on an archived campaign unarchives it (paused, or a draft when it never ran). Archiving is the way to put away a campaign: deleting erases its send history.
name: update_outreach_campaign_status
title: Pausar ou retomar cadência
